phases.title: Discovery & Requirements
phases.description: Conduct in-depth research and gather requirements for building a Postgres development platform similar to Firebase. Understand the core features needed such as hosted Postgres database, authentication, auto-generated APIs (REST, GraphQL, Realtime), serverless functions, file storage, and AI/vector embeddings toolkit. Align with stakeholders on the vision of providing an open-source, enterprise-grade alternative to Firebase using tools like Postgres, Realtime, PostgREST, GoTrue, Kong, and others mentioned in the README.

phases.title: Technical Planning & Architecture
phases.description: Design the overall system architecture for the Supabase platform, incorporating the various open-source components mentioned (Postgres, Realtime, PostgREST, GoTrue, Storage, pg_graphql, postgres-meta, Kong). Plan for integrating these components seamlessly to provide a Firebase-like developer experience. Define the technology stack, including Typescript, Rust, Python, Javascript, Java, Ruby, Go for client libraries. Outline the implementation roadmap and dependencies.

phases.title: UI/UX Design & Prototyping
phases.description: Design the user interface and experience for the Supabase platform, including the dashboard shown in the README. Prototype the developer workflows for managing the hosted Postgres database, authentication, APIs, functions, storage, and AI/vector embeddings. Optimize the UX for seamless integration of the various platform components and ensure a Firebase-like developer experience.

phases.title: Core Development
phases.description: Implement the core features of the Supabase platform, including the hosted Postgres database, authentication and authorization (GoTrue), auto-generated APIs (REST with PostgREST, GraphQL with pg_graphql, Realtime subscriptions), database functions, edge functions, file storage, and AI/vector embeddings toolkit. Integrate the various open-source components and ensure seamless interoperability.

phases.title: System Integration & Testing
phases.description: Conduct comprehensive integration testing to validate the end-to-end workflows and API connections between the various Supabase platform components (Postgres, Realtime, PostgREST, GoTrue, Storage, pg_graphql, postgres-meta, Kong). Test the interoperability with different client libraries (Typescript, Rust, Python, Javascript, Java, Ruby, Go) and ensure seamless developer experience across languages.

phases.title: Quality Assurance & Testing
phases.description: Perform rigorous testing of the Supabase platform, including functional, performance, security, and compatibility testing. Validate the core features such as hosted Postgres database, authentication, APIs (REST, GraphQL, Realtime), functions, storage, and AI/vector embeddings toolkit. Ensure the platform meets enterprise-grade quality standards and addresses the needs of developers seeking an open-source alternative to Firebase.

phases.title: Deployment & Distribution
phases.description: Set up the deployment and distribution processes for the Supabase platform, including packaging, hosting, and automation. Ensure seamless deployment of the various components (Postgres, Realtime, PostgREST, GoTrue, Storage, pg_graphql, postgres-meta, Kong) and client libraries (Typescript, Rust, Python, Javascript, Java, Ruby, Go). Implement deployment strategies for self-hosting and local development scenarios mentioned in the README.

phases.title: Launch & Documentation
phases.description: Prepare for the launch of the Supabase platform, including comprehensive documentation, marketing materials, and go-to-market strategies. Document the setup and usage of the core features (hosted Postgres, authentication, APIs, functions, storage, AI/vector embeddings) and the integration with different client libraries. Develop tutorials, sample projects, and resources to help developers get started with Supabase as an open-source alternative to Firebase.
